text.en: MOE Singapore, Primary Science Syllabus 2023: light, seeing, and the Sun as a primary source of light and heat provide curriculum connections. Astronomy here is enrichment.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部《小学科学课程纲要 2023》：光、看见物体，以及太阳作为光热主要来源，提供课纲接口。本主题的天文范围属于拓展。

note.en: Cached official PDF reviewed in preparation, updated Jan 2026; printed pp.20,75,78–80. No claim that this entire topic is a required primary astronomy unit. No syllabus file redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对官方缓存 PDF，2026 年 1 月更新版；印刷页 20、75、78–80。不把整个主题称作小学必修天文单元，不发行课纲原文件。

text.en: MOE Singapore, Primary Social Studies Syllabus 2020: people, places and environments provide local context, rather than an astronomy outcome.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部《小学社会科课程纲要 2020》：人与地方、环境可作本地背景，不提供天文学习成果。

note.en: Cached official PDF reviewed in preparation, updated Jan 2024; printed pp.16,23. Retained as a scope check; no syllabus file redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对官方缓存 PDF，2024 年 1 月更新版，印刷页 16、23。用于核对范围，不发行课纲原文件。

text.en: NASA Science, Sun Facts: the Sun is a star, supplies light and heat, and holds the solar system together by gravity. Its hot plasma has no solid surface; fusion in the core releases energy.
text.zh: NASA Science《太阳事实》：太阳是恒星，提供光热，以引力维系太阳系。高温等离子体没有固体表面，核心核聚变释放能量。

note.en: Introduction, Structure, Surface, Size and Distance reviewed in preparation and live recheck. Use a rounded diameter of 1.4 million km. The 700,000 km model radius is deliberately approximate; see S37. No source image redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段及本轮重读引言、结构、表面、大小与距离。直径采用约 140 万 km；模型半径 700,000 km 刻意取整，见 S37。不发行原图。

text.en: NASA Science, About Planets: eight planets in outward order; the inner rocky planets, gas giants and ice giants; Pluto remains in the solar system as a dwarf planet.
text.zh: NASA Science《行星概览》：八颗行星由内到外的顺序，内侧岩质行星、气态巨行星与冰巨行星；冥王星作为矮行星仍属太阳系。

note.en: Inner/Outer Planets and Dwarf Planets reviewed in preparation. Ice giant names composition, not a bare ice surface. Do not freeze changing small-body or moon totals. No source media redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对内外行星与矮行星段。冰巨行星名称描述组成，不表示裸露冰面。不固定会变动的小天体或卫星总数，不发行原媒体。

text.en: NASA/JPL SSD, Planetary Physical Parameters: mean radii and sidereal orbital periods for the eight planets supply the size and period comparisons.
text.zh: NASA/JPL SSD《行星物理参数》：八行星的平均半径与恒星公转周期，供大小和周期比较。

note.en: Planet rows and column definitions reviewed in preparation and live recheck. Diameters equal twice mean radii. Exact adopted radii and periods are retained in planet-reference.json; pupil-facing numbers are rounded. S37 records derived scales.
note.zh: 准备阶段及本轮重读行星行与列定义。直径为平均半径的两倍。采用的半径与周期保留于 planet-reference.json，正文取整；缩尺推导见 S37。

text.en: NASA/JPL SSD, Approximate Positions of the Planets: Table 1 supplies reference J2000 fitted semimajor axes, not fixed present-day distances.
text.zh: NASA/JPL SSD《行星近似位置》：表 1 提供 J2000 拟合半长轴参考值，并非固定的当日距离。

note.en: Table 1 and validity discussion reviewed in preparation and live recheck. Its fit covers 1800–2050; Earth uses the Earth–Moon barycentre row. This topic borrows a as a constant teaching-circle radius and does not implement or claim the table’s fitted ephemeris.
note.zh: 准备阶段及本轮重读表 1 与适用范围。拟合适用 1800–2050 年；地球采用地月质心一行。本主题借 a 作教学圆半径，不实现也不宣称拟合星历精度。

text.en: NASA/JPL SSD, Astrodynamic Parameters: the astronomical unit is exactly 149,597,870,700 m; the Julian year is 365.25 days and light speed is 299,792.458 km/s.
text.zh: NASA/JPL SSD《天体动力学参数》：天文单位精确定义为 149,597,870,700 m；儒略年为 365.25 日，光速为 299,792.458 km/s。

note.en: Parameter table reviewed in preparation. Divide AU metres by 1,000 for km. S37 derives the light-year and AU light time; the defined AU is not the actual Earth–Sun distance at every instant.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对参数表。天文单位米数除以 1,000 得 km。S37 推导光年与天文单位光行时间；单位定义不表示日地距时时相同。

text.en: NASA Science, Moons: natural satellites orbit larger bodies and travel with them through the solar system.
text.zh: NASA Science《卫星》：自然卫星绕较大天体运行，也随母体在太阳系中运动。

note.en: Natural-satellite overview reviewed in preparation. No changing overall moon count is used. The chapter identifies companion motion; phases and eclipses remain in the linked Sun–Earth–Moon topic.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对自然卫星概览。不使用变动的卫星总数。本章辨认伴星运动，月相与食保留在链接主题。

text.en: NASA Science, Asteroid Facts: most asteroids occupy the main belt between Mars and Jupiter; other asteroid paths also exist.
text.zh: NASA Science《小行星事实》：多数小行星位于火星与木星间的主带，另有其他轨道。

note.en: Overview and orbit discussion reviewed in preparation. The belt dots are schematic regional markers and not a density measurement or a packed wall. No numerical separation or density is claimed.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对概览与轨道段。带状点位是区域示意，不是密度测量，也不是密集岩墙。不声称数值间距或密度。

text.en: NASA Science, Comet Facts: icy dusty nuclei can release comae and tails when heated; dust and ion tails extend generally away from the Sun.
text.zh: NASA Science《彗星事实》：含冰尘埃的彗核受热可释放物质形成彗发与尾；尘尾和离子尾总体背向太阳。

note.en: Structure and tails reviewed in preparation and live recheck. Sunlight and solar wind affect the material differently. The local geometry and illustration do not measure tail widths, chemistry or brightness. No source artwork redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段及本轮重读结构与彗尾段。阳光和太阳风对物质的作用不同。局部几何与插图不测尾宽、化学过程或亮度，不发行原图。

text.en: NASA Science, Saturn Facts: rings consist of many pieces of ice and rock, rather than solid hoops.
text.zh: NASA Science《土星事实》：环由许多冰和岩石碎块组成，并非固体圆箍。

note.en: Ring section reviewed in preparation. Procedural ring annuli and the cover illustration are structural shorthand, not measured ring thickness or gaps. No source artwork redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对环段。程序环带与封面是结构简写，不量真实环厚与缝宽，不发行原图。

text.en: NASA GSFC StarChild, Why do stars twinkle: moving, nonuniform air bends starlight; low stars cross more air and often twinkle more.
text.zh: NASA GSFC StarChild《恒星为何闪烁》：移动且不均匀的空气使星光偏折；低处星光经过更多空气，往往闪得更明显。

note.en: Question 26 reviewed in preparation and live recheck. The lesson addresses usual atmospheric scintillation, not all intrinsic stellar variability. Its flux trace is a qualitative design calculation under S37.
note.zh: 准备阶段及本轮重读第 26 问。解释常见大气闪烁，不概括所有恒星自身变光；相对光通量曲线是 S37 的定性设计计算。

text.en: University of Wisconsin–Madison, astronomer James Lattis: planets usually twinkle less because their apparent discs partly average atmospheric fluctuations.
text.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校，天文学家 James Lattis：行星视圆面的不同光路能部分平均大气起伏，因此通常闪得少。

note.en: Expert explanation reviewed in preparation. Usually is essential: planets can twinkle, especially at low apparent altitude. The displayed source widths and ray spacing are schematic.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对专家说明。“通常”不可省略：行星也会闪，尤其在低处。显示光源宽度与光线间隔都是示意。

text.en: International Astronomical Union, The Constellations: modern constellations are bounded sky areas; figures and cultural pattern systems are related but distinct.
text.zh: 国际天文学联合会《星座》：现代星座是有边界的天区；图形与不同文化分组与此有关，但并不相同。

note.en: FAQ reviewed in preparation and live recheck. Recognition lines in this topic are original sparse aids, not official boundaries or cultural star-chart reproductions. No IAU chart redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段及本轮重读 FAQ。本主题少量识别连线为原创辅助，不是官方边界或文化星图复制品，不发行 IAU 图表。

text.en: Science Centre Singapore, Stargazing / Our Observatory: the observatory supplies local context for looking at the night sky from Singapore.
text.zh: 新加坡科学馆《观星与天文台》：天文台为从新加坡观察夜空提供本地联系。

note.en: Site identity and public context only. The preparation’s precise-coordinate claim is not adopted as verified official survey data. Latitude 1.3342 N and longitude 103.7357 E are DESIGN inputs under S37. No schedule, ticket promise or source image is reproduced.
note.zh: 只用于场所身份与公开背景。准备资料的精确坐标说法不当作已核实官方测绘值。北纬 1.3342、东经 103.7357 为 S37 教学输入，不复制活动时间、票务承诺或原图。

text.en: NASA Science, Our Milky Way Galaxy: How Big is Space: the solar system belongs to the Milky Way, whose stellar disc is roughly 100,000 light-years across.
text.zh: NASA Science《银河系与空间尺度》：太阳系属于银河系，恒星盘直径粗略约 10 万光年。

note.en: Galaxy-scale discussion reviewed in preparation. The rounded disc width is not a sharp edge or full halo size. The optional estimated population is not shown as a precise count; no source image redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对星系尺度段。取整盘宽不等于明确边缘或完整晕大小；不把可选恒星数量估计写成精确总数，不发行原图。

text.en: NASA/CXC/SAO Chandra, Proxima Centauri: the closest star beyond the Sun is about 4.24 light-years away.
text.zh: NASA/CXC/SAO Chandra《比邻星》：太阳以外最近的恒星距离约 4.24 光年。

note.en: Distance and identity reviewed in preparation. Proxima is not the bright naked-eye Alpha Centauri pair. The Sun is the closest star to Earth. No Chandra image or third-party media redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对距离与身份。比邻星不是明亮的肉眼半人马座 α 双星；离地球最近的恒星是太阳。不发行 Chandra 图像或第三方媒体。

text.en: Lunar and Planetary Institute, Stellar Evolution: Misconceptions and Educational Research: documented alternative ideas include the Sun not being a star and pattern stars being near each other.
text.zh: 月球与行星研究所《恒星演化误解与教育研究》：文献记录的替代观念包括太阳不是恒星、图案中的恒星彼此很近。

note.en: Public synthesis read in preparation via web tool; direct HTTP was blocked. Research samples discussed there are not Singapore primary pupils. Used to plan contrasts, without local prevalence claims or percentages.
note.zh: 准备阶段通过网页工具读取公开综述，直接 HTTP 被阻。所述样本不是新加坡小学生；只用于安排对照，不声称本地比例或误解率。

text.en: Julia D. Plummer, A cross-age study of children’s knowledge of apparent celestial motion, IJSE 2009: interviews document alternative accounts of the sky’s apparent movement.
text.zh: Julia D. Plummer，2009 年 IJSE《不同年龄儿童对天体视运动的认识》：访谈记录了对夜空视运动的不同解释。

note.en: Repository abstract read in preparation; full paper not read. The abstract describes 60 pupils across grades 1, 3 and 8. It motivates viewpoint comparisons, not a Singapore prevalence estimate.
note.zh: 准备阶段读取机构库摘要，未读全文。摘要描述小学一年级、三年级与八年级共 60 名学生；用于视点对照的规划，不估计新加坡比例。

text.en: Harvard–Smithsonian CfA MOSART, Student Misconceptions: summary findings include underestimated star distances and assumed fixed same-time constellation positions.
text.zh: 哈佛—史密森 CfA MOSART《学生误解》：公开摘要提到低估恒星距离、认为同一钟点星空总相同等观念。

note.en: Public summary read in preparation. No test items accessed and no account or terms accepted. Used as a planning probe; no invented frequencies or local claims.
note.zh: 准备阶段读取公开总结，不读取测题，不注册或接受条款。只作规划探针，不编造发生频率或本地结论。

text.en: IAU Office of Astronomy for Education, multilingual glossary: reference for English astronomy labels and simplified Chinese terminology.
text.zh: IAU 天文学教育办公室多语词汇表：用于核对英语天文词形与简体中文术语。

note.en: Index and selected terms checked in preparation; CC BY 4.0, credited to IAU OAE. Atlas definitions are independently written. Orbit means path here; orbital motion means movement. No claim that these are attested Singapore-standard Chinese labels.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对索引与相关词条；CC BY 4.0，署名 IAU OAE。Atlas 定义独立起草，区分轨道与公转，不称为已核实的新加坡标准中文词形。

text.en: David Nash / Astronexus, HYG Stellar Database licence: catalogue data are provided under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0.
text.zh: David Nash／Astronexus，HYG 恒星数据库许可：星表数据采用知识共享署名—相同方式共享 4.0。

note.en: Licence read in preparation. The selected HYG derivative retains a separate CC BY-SA file, attribution, version and source hash; Atlas prose and original recognition lines are not merged into that derivative.
note.zh: 准备阶段读取许可。HYG 选取派生数据保持独立 CC BY-SA 文件、署名、版本与来源哈希；Atlas 文字及原创识别线不混入该派生文件。

text.en: NASA, Images and Media Guidelines: source-media permissions must be checked separately from factual text.
text.zh: NASA《图像与媒体使用指南》：原媒体的使用权限必须与事实文字分别核对。

note.en: Policy reviewed in preparation. This topic redistributes no NASA image. Its approved generated graphite plates have their own production audit and do not inherit a source photograph’s status.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对政策。本主题不发行 NASA 图像；已批准的生成石墨图版另有制作审计，不承接某张原照片的许可身份。

text.en: NASA Science, Galaxies: galaxies are large gravity-bound systems of stars and other matter; the Sun’s system lies within the Milky Way.
text.zh: NASA Science《星系》：星系是由引力维系、含恒星与其他物质的大型系统，太阳系位于银河系内。

note.en: Overview reviewed in preparation and live recheck. The model does not put galactic rotation on the planetary year clock. Counts and large-scale dimensions remain approximate. No source media redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段及本轮重读概览。模型不把银河公转放到行星年钟上；数量与大尺度保持近似，不发行原媒体。

text.en: NASA Science, Meteors and Meteorites Facts: a meteor is an atmospheric light event; surviving material on the ground is a meteorite.
text.zh: NASA Science《流星与陨石事实》：流星是大气中的发光事件，落到地面的残留物质是陨石。

note.en: Terminology reviewed in preparation. A shooting star is not a falling stellar body. The event marker is schematic and does not model heating, ablation or impact.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对术语。俗称流星并非恒星掉落；事件标记为示意，不模拟加热、烧蚀或撞击。

text.en: NASA Science, Kepler’s Three Laws Explained: real planetary paths are ellipses and orbital speed varies along them.
text.zh: NASA Science《开普勒三定律》：真实行星路径是椭圆，沿轨道的速度会改变。

note.en: Laws and equal-area discussion reviewed in preparation. The teaching-circle approximation is explicitly different; angle = starting phase + 2π × elapsed time / reference period. No N-body integration or real ephemeris is claimed.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对定律与等面积说明。教学圆轨道另作披露；角度等于起始角加 2π 乘经过时间除以参考周期。不声称多体积分或真实星历。

text.en: Julia D. Plummer, Early Elementary Students’ Development of Astronomy Concepts in the Planetarium, JRST 2009: linked viewpoint and motion instruction informed the lesson planning.
text.zh: Julia D. Plummer，2009 年 JRST《低年级学生在天文馆中的天文概念发展》：视点与运动关联的教学研究供本主题规划参考。

note.en: Abstract only read in preparation; full paper not read or downloaded. The study used pre/post interviews with 63 first/second-grade pupils. It is not evidence that this Atlas activity has been tested or proven effective.
note.zh: 准备阶段只读摘要，未读或下载全文。研究对 63 名一年级、二年级学生作前后访谈；不证明这项 Atlas 活动已接受测试或有效。

text.en: David Nash / Astronexus, HYG README: catalogue field definitions, reference directions, distances and versioning guide the selected sample.
text.zh: David Nash／Astronexus，HYG README：字段、参考方向、距离与版本说明用于选择样本。

note.en: README reviewed in preparation; CC BY-SA 4.0. Right ascension is in hours, declination in degrees and distance in parsecs. Distance values are catalogue estimates, not newly measured Atlas distances. Invalid distances are not treated as zero.
note.zh: 准备阶段读取 README；CC BY-SA 4.0。赤经用小时、赤纬用度、距离用秒差距。距离是星表估计，不是 Atlas 新测量；无效距离不当零距离。

text.en: IAU Office of Astronomy for Education, Light Year / 光年: a light-year is a length, approximately 9.46 trillion km.
text.zh: IAU 天文学教育办公室《光年》：光年是长度，约 9.46 万亿 km。

note.en: Bilingual term page reviewed in preparation; CC BY 4.0, credited to IAU OAE. Atlas wording is original. Its coarse 9.5 trillion km and this topic’s 9.46 trillion km are compatible roundings; S37 shows the adopted calculation.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对双语词条；CC BY 4.0，署名 IAU OAE。Atlas 文字独立起草。词条粗取 9.5 万亿与本主题 9.46 万亿只是精度不同；采用计算见 S37。

text.en: US Naval Observatory, Computing Approximate Sidereal Time: Earth’s rotation relative to distant stars sets the time-angle used for local sky directions.
text.zh: 美国海军天文台《近似恒星时计算》：地球相对远方恒星的转动，决定本地星空方向所用的时间角。

note.en: Algorithm reviewed in preparation and live recheck. Approximate GMST is calculated from UTC, then longitude gives local sidereal time. No browser-local timezone, UT1 precision, precession or nutation is claimed; see S37 for the teaching approximation.
note.zh: 准备阶段及本轮重读算法。由 UTC 求近似 GMST，再用经度求地方恒星时。不依赖浏览器本地时区，不声称 UT1 精度、岁差或章动修正；教学近似见 S37。

text.en: US Naval Observatory, Computing Altitude and Azimuth: latitude, star direction and hour angle determine a geometric direction above the local horizon.
text.zh: 美国海军天文台《高度角与方位角计算》：由纬度、恒星方向与时角，求相对本地几何地平的方向。

note.en: Algorithm reviewed in preparation. Atlas uses east = −cosδ sinH; north = sinδ cosφ − cosδ cosH sinφ; up = sinδ sinφ + cosδ cosH cosφ; azimuth = atan2(east,north). Zenith direction is handled explicitly; no observed rise/set forecast is produced.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对算法。Atlas 以 east = −cosδ sinH、north = sinδ cosφ − cosδ cosH sinφ、up = sinδ sinφ + cosδ cosH cosφ，方位取 atan2(east,north)。天顶另作处理，不输出观测升落预报。

text.en: NASA Space Place, What Are Constellations: patterns depend on viewpoint; their stars can lie at different distances, and the annual nightward view changes.
text.zh: NASA Space Place《星座》：图案依赖视点，图中恒星距离可能不同，一年中夜晚朝向也会变化。

note.en: Pattern, distance and annual-view explanations reviewed in preparation. Daily sweep and annual same-clock-time changes are kept separate. Original sparse links help recognition without asserting a physical cluster.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对图案、距离与年内视野说明。区分一夜扫过与年内同钟点变化；原创稀疏连线只助识别，不声称物理星团。

text.en: China National Space Administration, planet-name article: reference for the Chinese forms 水星、金星、地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星、海王星.
text.zh: 中国国家航天局行星名称文章：核对水星、金星、地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星、海王星词形。

note.en: Terminology attestation read in preparation. Neptune is 海王星. This is a nomenclature reference, not evidence of a distinct Singapore terminology standard. No source page redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段读取中文名称。Neptune 使用海王星。该出处核对词形，不证明独立的新加坡用语标准，不发行原页面。

text.en: David Nash / Astronexus, HYG v4.1 catalogue: selected bright-star rows supply the static local-sky sample and catalogue depth view.
text.zh: David Nash／Astronexus，HYG v4.1 星表：选取亮星行，用于静态本地星空样本与星表深度视图。

note.en: Versioned catalogue read in preparation; only selected rows persisted. The separate CC BY-SA derivative records source checksum and attribution. Fixed J2000 directions omit proper motion and precession; the displayed bright-star sample is not a complete sky catalogue.
note.zh: 准备阶段读取版本化星表，只保留选定行。独立 CC BY-SA 派生文件记录来源校验和与署名。固定 J2000 方向省略自行、岁差；显示样本不是完整星表。

text.en: NASA GSFC Imagine the Universe, The Milky Way: our galaxy is a barred spiral with a disc and central structure.
text.zh: NASA GSFC Imagine the Universe《银河系》：银河系是棒旋星系，含盘与中央结构。

note.en: Structure discussion reviewed in preparation. The generated external view is a reconstruction, not a photograph taken from outside. No exact arm count, present-day Sun position or measured stellar-dot size is claimed. No source artwork redistributed.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对结构段。生成外部视图为重建，不称外拍照片；不锁定旋臂数目、当日太阳坐标或细点恒星大小，不发行原图。

text.en: NASA Science, Solar System Facts: Mercury and Venus have no natural moons.
text.zh: NASA Science《太阳系事实》：水星和金星没有自然卫星。

note.en: Moon identities reviewed in preparation. Avoid changing moon totals. A quasi-satellite is not treated as a planetary moon; no external service is needed at runtime.
note.zh: 准备阶段核对卫星身份。不使用变动总数，不把准卫星当行星卫星；运行时不请求外部服务。

text.en: Atlas design study for the solar-system topic: a generic multi-scale teaching model, not a measurement or current ephemeris. DESIGN: circular coplanar planetary paths use JPL reference semimajor axes and periods; all starting phases are zero; one model-year is 365.25 days. Sun radius is rounded to 700,000 km. The local-sky input near Singapore is 1.3342° N, 103.7357° E with fixed 2026 example dates and Singapore time. SIM: angular turns equal elapsed model-years divided by the reference period. For a 10 mm Earth, one AU is about 117.405 m, Neptune’s reference distance 3.5304 km, Jupiter diameter 109.733 mm and rounded Sun diameter 1.099 m. One light-year is 9,460,730,472,580.8 km and one-AU light time is 499.0048 s. These are derived comparisons.
text.zh: Atlas 太阳系主题设计研究：通用多尺度教学模型，不是实测或当日星历。DESIGN：共面圆形行星轨道采用 JPL 参考半长轴与周期，全部起始相位为零；模型年为 365.25 日。太阳半径取整为 700,000 km。本地星空采用新加坡附近北纬 1.3342°、东经 103.7357° 输入、2026 年固定示例日与新加坡时间。SIM：圈数等于经过模型年数除以参考周期。地球直径缩为 10 mm 时，一天文单位约 117.405 m，海王星参考距离约 3.5304 km，木星直径约 109.733 mm，取整太阳直径约 1.099 m。一光年为 9,460,730,472,580.8 km，一天文单位光行时间为 499.0048 s。以上均为推导比较。

note.en: Not measured values. Physical inputs come from S3,S5–S7; the deliberately rounded Sun differs from the earlier Sun–Earth–Moon topic. Scale length = physical km / (2 × Earth mean radius 6371.0084 km) × 0.01 m. AU light time = 149597870.7 / 299792.458; light-year = 299792.458 × 365.25 × 86400 km. Overview enlarges bodies and compresses gaps; size-row gaps are layout; distance mode uses a shared physical scale, with separately identified selectable markers. The point/disc twinkle uses Ij=1+A bj sin(2πt/4+phasej), b=[1,.8,.6,.4], phase=[0,π/2,π,3π/2], A=0/.1/.3 for no air/high/low; disc averages four rays. At high t=1 s, point=1.10 and disc=1.01. Arbitrary relative flux is qualitative, not weather data. Comet p=(3(cosE−.6),0,−2.4sinE), E at selected quarter steps; ion tail uses unit(p) away from the Sun and the dust tail is offset schematically. Local sky uses S30/S31 approximate GMST and geometric east/north/up, UTC=SGT−8 hours, fixed J2000 HYG sample under separate CC BY-SA, and no precession, nutation, proper motion, refraction, extinction, weather or terrain. Model coordinates are DESIGN, not verified official survey coordinates. Frames are selected snapshots with run=false. Galactic structure, source widths, ray spacing and display phases are schematic; the galaxy is not animated on the planetary clock. The small Earth-viewpoint sphere is a static reference, not a synchronously rotating globe.
note.zh: 不是实测值。物理输入来自 S3、S5–S7；取整太阳输入与早先太阳地月主题刻意不同。缩尺长度 = 真实 km ÷（2 × 地球平均半径 6371.0084 km）× 0.01 m。天文单位光行时间 = 149597870.7 ÷ 299792.458；光年 = 299792.458 × 365.25 × 86400 km。总览放大天体并压缩间距；大小行间隔只作排版；距离模式共用物理比例，另行标明可点标记。闪烁采用 Ij=1+A bj sin(2πt/4+phasej)，b=[1,.8,.6,.4]、phase=[0,π/2,π,3π/2]，无空气／较高／较低取 A=0/.1/.3，圆面取四光路平均；较高光路 t=1 s 时，点为 1.10，圆面为 1.01。任意相对光通量只作定性示意，不是天气数据。彗核 p=(3(cosE−.6),0,−2.4sinE)，E 取选定四分步；离子尾沿 unit(p) 背向太阳，尘尾示意偏转。本地天空依 S30/S31 近似 GMST 与几何东、北、上方向计算，UTC=新加坡时间减 8 小时；固定 J2000 HYG 样本保持独立 CC BY-SA，省略岁差、章动、自行、折射、消光、天气与地形。坐标是 DESIGN，不是已核实官方测绘值。画面均为选定快照，run=false。星系结构、光源宽度、光线间隔与显示相位为示意；星系不沿行星年钟运行。 小地球视点球是静态参照，不是同步转动的地球。
